summary: This repository provides a suite of tools designed to assist researchers in the academic writing process, from planning to publication, while emphasizing human oversight to avoid common pitfalls of AI-generated content. It aims to enhance the quality of academic writing by managing references, formatting citations, and ensuring logical consistency.
use_cases: Organizing research paper structure using Socratic dialogue
Verifying data and references for academic papers
Improving writing quality through style calibration and checks
